models.name: Warden-TRUST
models.foundation: Deterministic provenance, freshness, synthetic-data and fail-closed reliability labels are integrated with evidence and reports.
models.nextGate: Pinned weights, trained calibration, source-history features and evaluation data.

models.name: Warden-ENVELOPE
models.foundation: Advisory event contract only; no geometry or airspace model implementation.
models.nextGate: Validated non-operational geometry fixtures, evaluation, and reviewed safety limits.

models.name: Warden-CHANGE
models.foundation: Advisory event contract only; no image-change inference implementation.
models.nextGate: Pinned local model choice, labeled evaluation set, and uncertainty calibration.

models.name: Warden-GEO
models.foundation: Advisory event contract only; no geolocation inference implementation.
models.nextGate: Validated camera calibration and labeled geolocation error evaluation.

models.name: Warden-SKY
models.foundation: Advisory event contract only; no traffic or deconfliction inference implementation.
models.nextGate: Validated non-DAA fixtures, uncertainty evaluation, and independent safety review.

models.name: Warden-TRACK
models.foundation: Advisory event contract only; no track-fusion inference implementation.
models.nextGate: Local sensor adapters, labeled track fixtures, and track-continuity evaluation.

models.name: Warden-TH
models.foundation: Seeded fault generator, 120-second/2 Hz missingness-age-trust-aware features, deterministic baseline and CPU ONNX worker are integrated. A hash-pinned synthetic-only prototype exists outside Git; it is not installed or field validated.
models.nextGate: Independent review of the synthetic results, then license-reviewed representative non-operational/SITL data and per-airframe calibration under a separately approved safety protocol; synthetic targets do not establish flight readiness.

models.name: Warden-NAV
models.foundation: Deterministic scalar navigation residuals, 60% presence abstention and coordinate-free output are integrated.
models.nextGate: Pinned weights, known airframe class, validated residual thresholds, and representative evaluation.

limitations: This registry describes implementation readiness, not flight or operational readiness.
The Warden-TH prototype is trained only on project-generated synthetic telemetry; its hash manifest is checked in, but weights are not installed in the local runtime cache.
Held-out seeded-synthetic targets were met; those results are not field, SITL, flight or safety validation.
Any future learned inference must remain local by default and require explicit user selection; no silent external fallback is permitted.
